Read the following statement:

"Learning a new language brings many valuable opportunities in education, career development, and cultural exchange. However, learners also face numerous challenges along the way."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing both the advantages and challenges of learning a new language. Support your arguments with specific reasons and relevant examples.
title: Task 2.1: Advantages and Challenges of Learning a New Language
content:
Read the following statement:

"Learning a new language brings many valuable opportunities in education, career development, and cultural exchange. However, learners also face numerous challenges along the way."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing both the advantages and challenges of learning a new language. Support your arguments with specific reasons and relevant examples.

body1.example: For instance, my brother was stuck in a low-paid job because he could not speak English fluently. Therefore, he decided to take an evening English course and practice speaking every day with online tools. As a result, he finally earned a B2 certificate and got promoted at an international company. If he had not learned a second language, he would not have been able to improve his living standard so quickly.
body1.focus: Advantages: Better career chances and broader cultural knowledge
body1.frame: Mở: On the one hand, learning a new language brings a lot of advantages in several ways | Ruột ĐOẠN 1 | Chốt: Clearly, these benefits make learning a new language appealing to many people.
body1.point: A very important point to consider is that learning a new language opens better career opportunities and helps improve people's living standard. This means that fluent speakers can apply for international companies, earn higher salaries, and study abroad more easily. Another point I would like to make is that a foreign language helps learners broaden their mind and enjoy cultural exchange. This is because of the fact that reading foreign books and talking with international friends gives them a deeper understanding of people, culture, and tradition.

body2.example: For example, I was eager to learn Japanese while studying full-time at university last year. For this reason, I got to struggle with memorizing new vocabulary after long classes and felt very shy speaking with native teachers. If I had not kept practicing steadily with short daily lessons, I would not have been able to know that learning a language takes huge patience and regular effort.
body2.focus: Challenges: High costs of time and money, and speaking shyness
body2.frame: Mở: On the other hand, the disadvantages of learning a new language are undeniable | Ruột ĐOẠN 2 | Chốt: It is clear that time pressure and speaking shyness can create serious drawbacks if ignored.
body2.point: In fact, mastering a new language costs a great deal of time, effort, and money for courses or textbooks. This happens because when busy students and workers try to fit daily practice into a tight schedule, it easily leads to tiredness and giving up halfway. In addition, many learners feel nervous about making grammar mistakes, which stops them from speaking naturally in real conversations.

hint.conclusion: In conclusion, learning a new language brings both pros and cons. While people can benefit from better career opportunities and broader cultural knowledge, they also need to handle heavy time commitments, course costs, and speaking shyness. Therefore, both individuals and schools should work together to make the most of language learning responsibly.

intro.ld2: high costs of time and money as well as speaking shyness

Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 2.2: Impacts of Workplace Stress on Employees and Companies
Nội dung chi tiết:
Read the following statement:

"In today's fast-paced and competitive work environment, workplace stress has become a serious concern that affects not only the health and well-being of individual employees but also the overall performance of companies."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing the effects of workplace stress on both employees and companies. Provide specific reasons and examples to support your viewpoint.
title: Task 2.2: Impacts of Workplace Stress on Employees and Companies
content:
Read the following statement:

"In today's fast-paced and competitive work environment, workplace stress has become a serious concern that affects not only the health and well-being of individual employees but also the overall performance of companies."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing the effects of workplace stress on both employees and companies. Provide specific reasons and examples to support your viewpoint.

body1.example: For instance, my brother was given too many tasks and tight deadlines at his sales company last year. Therefore, he decided to skip lunch, work overtime, and check work emails late at night. As a result, he finally suffered from severe stomach pain and spent his savings on hospital bills. If he had not worked under such heavy stress, he would not have been so sick and exhausted.
body1.focus: Effects on employees: Poor physical and mental health and lost work-life balance
body1.frame: Mở: First and foremost, workplace stress leads to several serious negative effects | Ruột ĐOẠN 1 | Chốt: Clearly, these are the key impacts of workplace stress.
body1.point: A very important point to consider is that heavy workplace stress seriously harms employees' physical and mental health. This means that workers who skip meals, sleep poorly, and worry about tight deadlines easily suffer from headaches, fatigue, and burnout. Another point I would like to make is that constant office pressure damages family relationships. This is because of the fact that stressed workers bring frustration home and fail to reach a healthy balance between work and family time.

body2.example: For example, I was working as a part-time assistant at a busy office where staff often felt overworked and tired. For this reason, I got to see three experienced workers quit within six months, forcing the manager to spend extra money training new staff. If I had not seen those mistakes and resignations myself, I would not have been able to know that workplace stress hurts company performance so badly.
body2.focus: Effects on companies: Lower productivity and high staff turnover
body2.frame: Mở: Secondly, there are many serious effects of this issue | Ruột ĐOẠN 2 | Chốt: It is clear that these consequences cannot be overlooked.
body2.point: In fact, high stress levels directly lower work quality and reduce overall company productivity. This happens because when employees feel exhausted and lose concentration, it easily leads to costly mistakes, missed deadlines, and weak teamwork. In addition, unhappy staff often decide to change jobs every few months, causing high staff turnover and extra hiring costs for businesses.

hint.conclusion: In conclusion, workplace stress in modern companies is closely linked to poor employee health and requires practical steps to prevent lower productivity and high staff turnover. Therefore, both employees and companies need to take steady, practical actions to reduce this problem in the long run.

intro.ld1: poor physical and mental health among employees
intro.ld2: lower productivity and higher staff turnover for companies

Nội dung chi tiết:
Read the following statement:

"Social networking platforms have become an integral part of modern communication, allowing users to stay connected and share information instantly. However, many people are worried about their negative effects on mental health, privacy, and real-life relationships."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing the advantages and disadvantages of social networking sites. Give reasons and relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
title: Task 2.3: Advantages and Disadvantages of Social Networking Sites
content:
Read the following statement:

"Social networking platforms have become an integral part of modern communication, allowing users to stay connected and share information instantly. However, many people are worried about their negative effects on mental health, privacy, and real-life relationships."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing the advantages and disadvantages of social networking sites. Give reasons and relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

body1.example: For instance, my brother was struggling to find study partners when preparing for his university exam in a small town. Therefore, he decided to join an English study group on Facebook to share notes and practice speaking. As a result, he finally met like-minded friends and passed his exam with high marks. If he had not used social networking sites wisely, he would not have been able to find such helpful study support.
body1.focus: Advantages: Fast communication and instant information sharing
body1.frame: Mở: On the one hand, using social networking sites brings a lot of advantages in several ways | Ruột ĐOẠN 1 | Chốt: Clearly, these benefits make social networking sites appealing to many people.
body1.point: A very important point to consider is that social networking sites are fast and convenient for busy people in modern-day society to stay connected. This means that friends and family members can send messages, make video calls, and share daily updates across long distances for free. Another point I would like to make is that these platforms help users broaden their mind and exchange useful knowledge. This is because of the fact that people can follow trusted news pages, join learning groups, and meet like-minded people with shared hobbies.

body2.example: For example, I was spending over three hours every evening scrolling through TikTok and Instagram last year. For this reason, I got to feel insecure seeing friends' luxury vacation photos and realized I barely talked with my parents during dinner. If I had not cut down my daily screen time, I would not have been able to know that social media can harm mental health and real-life relationships so easily.
body2.focus: Disadvantages: Peer pressure, privacy risks, and weaker real-life relationships
body2.frame: Mở: On the other hand, the disadvantages of using social networking sites are undeniable | Ruột ĐOẠN 2 | Chốt: It is clear that peer pressure and privacy risks can create serious drawbacks if ignored.
body2.point: In fact, spending too much time on social platforms often hurts mental health and creates terrible peer pressure. This happens because when young people constantly compare their everyday lives with friends' luxury posts, it easily leads to feeling stressed, lonely, and unhappy. In addition, sharing private details online allows cyber criminals to steal personal identities, while staring at phones reduces face-to-face interaction.

hint.conclusion: In conclusion, using social networking sites brings both pros and cons. While people can benefit from fast communication and useful information sharing, they also need to handle peer pressure, privacy risks, and weaker real-life bonds. Therefore, both individuals and tech companies should work together to make the most of social networking sites responsibly.

Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 2.4: Benefits of Staying Single in Modern Society
Nội dung chi tiết:
Read the following statement:

"Nowadays, an increasing number of young adults choose to stay single longer rather than getting married early."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing the main benefits of staying single. Support your arguments with clear reasons and specific examples.
title: Task 2.4: Benefits of Staying Single in Modern Society
content:
Read the following statement:

"Nowadays, an increasing number of young adults choose to stay single longer rather than getting married early."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing the main benefits of staying single. Support your arguments with clear reasons and specific examples.

body1.example: For instance, my brother was eager to build his career after graduating from university. Therefore, he decided to stay single through his twenties, take extra training courses, and save half of his salary. As a result, he finally bought a small apartment and improved his living standard. If he had not stayed single longer, he would not have been so financially stable before starting a family.
body1.focus: Benefit 1: Career focus and financial stability
body1.frame: Mở: First and foremost, people should recognize that staying single helps young adults build a stable career and save money | Ruột ĐOẠN 1 | Chốt: Clearly, career and financial stability brings undeniable value in modern life.
body1.point: A very important point to consider is that staying single in your twenties gives you full freedom to build a stable career and save enough money before raising a family. This means that young workers can take evening training courses, work on exciting projects, and earn promotions without worrying about heavy family bills. Another point I would like to make is that single adults learn to manage their own money wisely. This is because of the fact that handling rent and savings independently prepares them well for future responsibilities.

body2.example: For example, I was able to use my weekends freely over the past two years to join an English club and travel with close friends. For this reason, I got to broaden my mind, meet like-minded people, and feel refreshed every Monday morning. If I had not enjoyed this single period, I would not have been able to know that personal freedom supports self-development and mental health so much.
body2.focus: Benefit 2: Personal freedom, mental health, and self-development
body2.frame: Mở: Secondly, there are further arguments in support of the idea that staying single allows more personal freedom and self-development | Ruột ĐOẠN 2 | Chốt: It is clear that personal freedom plays an important role.
body2.point: In fact, living single gives young people valuable time to enjoy personal freedom and invest in self-development. This happens because when adults do not have strict family duties after work, it easily leads to learning new hobbies, exercising regularly, and recharging their batteries. In addition, having quiet personal space helps relieve stress and lets individuals truly understand what they want in life.

hint.conclusion: In conclusion, I strongly agree that staying single longer brings clear benefits for young adults, mainly because it helps them build a stable career and supports personal freedom and self-development. Therefore, both individuals and families should work together to make the most of this lifestyle choice responsibly.

group: Đề thi thực tế HCMUE 22/11/2026 (Sáng - Ca 2)
title: Task 2.5: Causes and Solutions of Children Spending Excessive Time on Electronic Devices
content:
Read the following statement:

"Children today are spending an alarming number of hours using smartphones, tablets, and computers instead of playing outdoors or interacting with their families."

Write an essay to an educated reader analyzing the main causes of this trend and proposing practical solutions for parents, schools, and society.

body1.example: For instance, my brother was working overtime almost every evening and felt too tired to play outdoors with his young son. Therefore, he decided to let his son use a tablet after dinner so he could finish office emails quietly. As a result, his son finally spent four hours every night playing mobile games instead of talking with the family. If my brother had not used the tablet as a babysitter, his son would not have been so glued to the screen.
body1.focus: Main causes: Busy parents lacking time and children having weak self-control
body1.frame: Mở: First and foremost, there are several major causes leading to children spending excessive time on electronic devices | Ruột ĐOẠN 1 | Chốt: Clearly, these are the key causes of children spending excessive time on electronic devices.
body1.point: A very important point to consider is that many parents work all day and fail to spend enough time talking with or guiding their children. This means that busy families often hand smartphones or tablets to kids just to keep them quiet at home. Another point I would like to make is that children lack proper guidance and self-control while safe outdoor play spaces are limited in big cities. This is because of the fact that colorful online games and videos are designed to grab young minds, making kids prefer screens over real-life play.

body2.example: For example, parents can set a phone-free family hour after dinner to walk or play board games together, while local primary schools and communities organize free afternoon football and music clubs for students.
body2.focus: Practical solutions for parents, schools, and local communities
body2.frame: Mở: In order to resolve such problems, both individuals and organizations should take practical measures | Ruột Solutions (Cá nhân + Tổ chức + Education)
body2.point: One primary solution would be that individuals, especially parents, should reach a healthy balance between work and family time, set clear daily screen limits, and spend quality time with their children. In addition, schools and local communities need to build safe playgrounds, run active sports and art clubs, and encourage face-to-face interaction after class. Above all, education plays a key role in tackling this issue, because people need to be aware of its impacts so that they can act responsibly.

hint.conclusion: In conclusion, children spending excessive time on electronic devices is closely linked to busy parents and weak self-control and requires practical steps such as clear family screen limits and active school programs. Therefore, both schools and families need to take steady, practical actions to reduce this problem in the long run.
